study type: Mixed-method (retrospective, cross-sectional questionnaire and interview data)
exposure: Lactation support in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs)
outcome: Compliance with existing lactation support recommendations
cohort: Mothers of very low birth weight (VLBW, <1500g) infants who were cared for in German NICUs.
finding: Lactation support in German NICUs is often inadequate and does not comply with recommendations, leading to difficulties in maintaining lactation over time despite successful initiation in most cases.
cross-section timing: Retrospective, reflecting mothers' experiences after their infant's NICU stay.
